title: FAST CROSS-BODY SWEEP
pose: The LEFT anatomical card elbow drives forward. Card forearm sweeps ACROSS THE FRONT OF CHEST from screen RIGHT toward screen LEFT, hand centered just LEFT of sternum, wrist still curled, cards at fingertips. Shoulders drop forward with motion and knees extend slightly. The raised windup clearly becomes a fast compact cross-body whip. Do NOT extend card arm to the RIGHT.
